answer_1.quote: we propose a new task to decompose complex sentences into a covering set of simple sentences

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we use BLEU with four-grams (BL4) and BERTScore (BS). We also include descriptive measures specific to our task. To indicate whether a model retains roughly the same number of words as the source sentence in the target output, we report average number of tokens per simple sentence (#T/SS). To capture the correspondence between the number of target simple sentences in the ground truth and model predictions, we use percentage of samples where the model predicts the correct number of simple sentences (Match #SS).
